package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func completionItem(types ...string) LearningPathItem {
	item := LearningPathItem{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "test"}
	for _, typ := range types {
		item.FrozenRequirements = append(item.FrozenRequirements, LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: typ, Required: true, SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString(), RevisionID: uuid.NewString()}})
	}
	return item
}
func completionFact(item LearningPathItem, index int) LessonActivityFact {
	r := item.FrozenRequirements[index]
	return LessonActivityFact{ItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: r.ID, Type: r.Type, SourceID: r.SourceReference.ID, SourceRevisionID: r.SourceReference.RevisionID, FactID: uuid.NewString()}
}
func TestLessonCompletionRequiredOptionalReplayAndOrdering(t *testing.T) {
	for _, types := range [][]string{{"theory_acknowledged"}, {"practice_completed"}, {"theory_acknowledged", "quiz_passed"}, {"quiz_passed", "practice_completed", "practice_completed"}} {
		for _, reverse := range []bool{false, true} {
			i := completionItem(types...)
			i.FrozenRequirements = append(i.FrozenRequirements, LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "practice_completed", SourceReference: LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString(), RevisionID: uuid.NewString()}})
			for n := range types {
				index := n
				if reverse {
					index = len(types) - 1 - n
				}
				fact := completionFact(i, index)
				updated, changed, err := SatisfyLessonRequirement(i, fact)
				if err != nil || !changed {
					t.Fatalf("apply %v", err)
				}
				if n < len(types)-1 && updated.Status != LearningPathItemInProgress {
					t.Fatal("premature completion")
				}
				i = updated
				_, changed, err = SatisfyLessonRequirement(i, fact)
				if err != nil || changed {
					t.Fatal("duplicate transition")
				}
			}
			if i.Status != LearningPathItemCompleted {
				t.Fatal("optional blocks completion")
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestLessonCompletionIndependentExecutionsAndExactSource(t *testing.T) {
	a := completionItem("quiz_passed")
	b := a
	b.ID = uuid.NewString()
	fact := completionFact(a, 0)
	fact.Type = "quiz_failed"
	if _, _, err := SatisfyLessonRequirement(a, fact); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed quiz accepted")
	}
	fact = completionFact(a, 0)
	if _, _, err := SatisfyLessonRequirement(b, fact); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign item accepted")
	}
	fact.SourceRevisionID = uuid.NewString()
	if _, _, err := SatisfyLessonRequirement(a, fact); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("different revision accepted")
	}
}
func TestFrozenContentRetainsQuestionsWithoutKeys(t *testing.T) {
	raw := json.RawMessage(`{"title":"lesson","private":"secret","tasks":[{"id":"task","code_structure":{"expected_answers":["secret"]},"tests":[{"id":"q","kind":"single_choice","variants":[{"id":"a","text":"option","is_correct":true,"correct_order":1,"group_id":"expected","group_source_key":"secret"}],"groups":[{"id":"g","title":"label"}]}]}]}`)
	b, err := PublicLessonContent(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, secret := range []string{"secret", "is_correct", "correct_order", "group_id", "expected_answers"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(b), secret) {
			t.Fatalf("key leaked %s", secret)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(b), "option") || !strings.Contains(string(b), "single_choice") {
		t.Fatal("questions lost")
	}
}
